_comment: Bulk narration lane. Kokoro-82M, Apache-2.0, 82M params, no cloning - 47 fixed voices. Use for anything where per-word diffusion cost is absurd: product-catalogue reads, IVR prompts, long explainer beds, draft scratch tracks before a VibeVoice or Qwen final.
_save_node: SaveAudioMP3 is marked DEPRECATED in current ComfyUI in favour of SaveAudioAdvanced, but it is the right choice on a pinned base: worker-comfyui 5.10.0 fixes a ComfyUI version, and the older node is certainly present there while SaveAudioAdvanced may not be. Revisit on the next base-image bump - if a graph ever 400s on this node, swap to SaveAudio (FLAC, never deprecated) rather than guessing at the newer name. quality options are exactly: V0, 128k, 320k.
_french_warning: ENGLISH ONLY in practice. Kokoro ships exactly ONE French voice (ff_siwis), graded B- on under 11 hours of training data. That is hobby quality and must not ship to a francophone client. For French bulk narration use ../voice-qwen (Qwen3-TTS, French WER 2.858) even though it costs more per word. See stack-docs/VOICE-CATALOGUE.md.
_node_names: Exact class_type and input names come from stavsap/comfyui-kokoro and can drift between node versions. If the graph 400s on validation, GET /object_info on a running instance and re-read the schema - do not guess.
